name: duopore-public-week-capacity-feasibility
description: Check whether your routine plans fit each day's available time.
keywords: check if your week will fit

interface.shortDescription: Check if your week will fit
interface.longDescription: Check whether your routine plans fit each day's available time. Enter daily minutes, planned activities and the buffer you want to keep. See spare time or overload for each day and the week as a whole. For adults planning their own week. The app shows the time gap; you decide which activities to change.
capabilities: Check if your week will fit
defaultPrompt: Do my planned routines fit the time I have this week?
Show which days are overloaded after keeping my chosen buffer.

positive.prompt: Use Week Capacity Feasibility with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs.
